content: Shabeeb TK is a Python Full Stack Developer based in Kerala, India, focusing on backend architecture, secure APIs, React/Next.js user experiences, and clean production delivery. He was promoted to Senior Development Engineer at CaretCloud Technology Pvt Ltd.
Core technologies include Python, Django, Django REST Framework, FastAPI, React, Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, Celery, WebSockets, JWT, Multi-tenant SaaS, and SAML SSO.

As a Senior Development Engineer at CaretCloud Technology Pvt Ltd (May 2024 - Mar 2026), Shabeeb was promoted from Associate Development Engineer. He worked as a core backend owner in product SaaS delivery. He designed multi-tenant architecture with Django, DRF, and PostgreSQL plus SSO/MFA with Redis and Celery. He built and maintained 50+ REST APIs for authentication, admin workflows, and service integrations, and contributed to frontend-aligned product delivery by integrating APIs with React/Next.js experiences and realtime workflows.

Key projects: 1) Goatza (https://goatza.com) - A sports networking platform connecting players, coaches, and scouts with ranked feed and real-time chat (Stack: Django, DRF, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, WebSockets). 2) Playoff (https://github.com/shabeebtk/turf-booking-management-django-rest-framework-backend.git) - A turf booking platform with slot booking, public games, participant chat, and production deployment on AWS (Stack: Django, DRF, AWS EC2, Nginx, Gunicorn, Daphne). 3) RedOrange AI (https://redorange.ai/) - An enterprise AI compliance platform project delivered at CaretCloud, focused on multi-tenant security, SSO, and integration-driven workflows (Stack: Django, DRF, FastAPI, SAML SSO, MFA, Redis, Celery).

Why hire Shabeeb: He brings strong backend ownership, product thinking, and frontend-backend full-stack execution. He has delivered enterprise SaaS systems, production integrations, and realtime user experiences with a focus on quality, scalability, and security.
